items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak said he now considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim. Realistic chance for Week 2.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach upgrade to DTD with realistic Week 2 return.
items.implication: Monitor practice; stash/start if active vs LAC.
items.opportunity: Full TE1 role if cleared; Mayer temporary.

items.text: Malik Nabers in first game since ACL+meniscus: 52% snaps (36/69), 71% routes (24/34), team-high 31% target share (9), 6-69-0, emerged healthy.
items.why: First game back post-ACL; healthy finish with strong route/target rates.
items.implication: Start with confidence ROS; volume confirms role.
items.opportunity: 71% routes and 31% targets signal WR1 usage if snaps climb.

items.text: AJ Brown high-ankle sprain; placed on IR, expected miss ~6 weeks (no surgery).
items.why: High ankle more serious; IR designation.
items.implication: Miss Weeks 2-6+; drop in shallow or stash IR.

items.text: EXPECTED: Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Rome Odunze (calf). NOT: Alvin Kamara (knee). NO NEWS: Malik Nabers (knee). Activated Josh Williams.
items.implication: Kamara out boosts Etienne; Love/Odunze play; Nabers pending (resolved active).

items.text: Disappointing box score for Colston Loveland but 92% route participation; two almost-plays. Buying low everywhere possible.
items.why: Elite route share despite low production; buy opportunity.
items.implication: Hold/buy; TE upside in Bears offense.

items.text: Kyler Murray in concussion protocol; status in medical hands. Uncertain for Week 2.
items.why: Hard hit, ruled out W1; protocol.

items.text: Surprised Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/7/5; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Kamara absence did not yield full workhorse; Miller/Donaldson involved.
items.implication: Temper Etienne RB1 expectations if Kamara returns or split persists.
items.opportunity: Etienne still lead but committee risk; Miller handcuff upside.
items.conflict: Pre-game proj linked dominate to Kamara out.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid appears over PCL: 74% snaps (42/57), 69% routes (22/32 Allen dropbacks). Will move needle when on field.
items.implication: TE1 upside with Allen; start confidently.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious; day-to-day, MRI upcoming. Would have returned if playoff game. Coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Left early but not serious; playoff-return threshold.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to other BAL WRs.

items.text: Risk/reward decoy possible but starting Malik Nabers everywhere post-active.
Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere. Wouldn't activate if worried about injury.
items.why: Active vs LAC; ankle cleared enough.

items.text: Marvin Harrison has zero career games with 8+ catches. Kendrick Bourne (AZ debut, age 31) went 8-75-0.
items.why: Historical volume ceiling concern; Bourne stole.
items.implication: Temper MHJ boom expectations; target competition.

items.text: Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps; Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks off to side early week (groin).
items.why: Hubbard lead but Brooks involved; possible groin limit.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 performance signals larger role.
